subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be split into a narrow `heartbeat.session` precedence bug fix and a separate Telegram DM default-isolation product decision?
rationale: The configured heartbeat-session path is a broken documented contract, but the requested default Telegram DM isolation conflicts with current docs and tests that preserve main-session sharing by default.

options.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
options.body: Honor configured `heartbeat.session` for exec/system-event wakes, migrate or preserve relevant pending events safely, and leave current Telegram DM defaults unchanged.

options.title: Change Telegram DM default isolation too
options.body: Move Telegram/direct-message defaults toward per-channel-peer isolation, accepting a compatibility-sensitive migration, docs, and doctor decision.

options.title: Fold into broader heartbeat entries
options.body: Defer this bug to the broader native per-session heartbeat scheduling design, leaving explicit-session users exposed longer.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
recommendation.body: Honor configured `heartbeat.session` for exec/system-event wakes, migrate or preserve relevant pending events safely, and leave current Telegram DM defaults unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses current heartbeat/session routing ownership and compatibility policy, and current central-file history points to steipete as the best routing owner available from the checked-out history.
